title: Production acceptance: prove the independent visible and scannable QR gate
evidence_required: FT-005-AC-002 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: TASK-079 changes no application behavior and only evaluates the authorized production corpus, so inducing a pre-change behavior failure would falsify the accepted setup and absence of an evidence artifact says nothing about current behavior; alternative proof: evaluate the FT-005 QR/latency criteria for all twenty authorized stable Attempt rows, preserve a pre-existing passing observation as GREEN when present, and require at least nineteen of those same rows to be fully visible/scannable and below 10000 ms while timeout/no-match remain failures; do not apply a server-correctness filter or calculate a joint intersection/pass set; decisive comparison: redacted twenty-row QR/latency manifest and explicit independent 19/20 count; artifact: evaluator record, timing/scan receipts and redacted manifest under .tasks/TASK-079-T3-FT-005-W3/.
purpose: Make the final production-only decision on the independent same-twenty visible/scannable QR performance target after all FT-005 implementation outcomes are complete.
success_outcome: At least nineteen of the same twenty controlled Attempts pass FT-005's complete target-screen rendering, one-clock under-10-second visibility, programmatic QR decode and representative-phone scanning.
anti_goals: Do not implement or repair application behavior, configuration, deployment or FT-004 server-correctness claims in this task.
Do not synthesize, replace, down-sample or exclude rows from the authorized twenty-Attempt corpus.
Do not claim FT-006 phone-session continuation, production rollout or recovery after primary loss.

forbidden_scope: Application source, canonical contract or deployment repair
Production secret mutation, participant identity disclosure or unapproved data capture
Operator/default database, session or media mutation beyond the authorized controlled run
stop_conditions: The authorized twenty stable Attempt IDs or the FT-005 production evaluator are unavailable.
The configured pilot screen/camera/client or representative phone set is unavailable or materially differs from the accepted controlled setup.
A passing result would require excluding timeout/no-match, changing the denominator, fabricating a scan or combining different Attempt sets.
The probe would require new production authority, unsafe secret handling or unapproved participant data retention.

constraints: Use exactly the same twenty stable attempt_id values as the controlled production corpus; record only FT-005 QR/latency observations and do not consume FT-004 correctness evidence.
Run on the accepted 43-inch landscape logical 1920x1080 client setup with an authorized pilot evaluator and representative real phones.
Measure from reference_series_ready_at through full QR visibility on one client monotonic clock; never subtract client and server wall clocks.
Retain only redacted task-owned artifacts and record evaluator role, criterion, conditions, observed values and decisive per-row pass/fail comparison.
This final task has no dependents and may remain planned until its external prerequisites and authorization are satisfied.
invariants: All twenty rows remain in the denominator and timeout/no-match are failures.
A row passes only when every FT-005 render, timing, decode and representative-phone conjunct passes; server correctness is evaluated separately by FT-004.
At least nineteen of the same twenty rows must pass; evidence from another corpus cannot substitute.
No production/application mutation may turn a failing acceptance run into a pass inside this task.
verification_targets: Record the authorized redacted same-twenty manifest, one-clock values, target-screen result, programmatic decode, representative-phone scan and explicit independent 19/20 QR/latency count.

Independently confirm no row exclusion, cross-clock subtraction, server-correctness filter, joint intersection/pass set, fabricated evaluator result, secret disclosure or task-external state mutation.
